name: Generic SDL/XInput Gamepad
controls: Left stick X: steer | RT/LT: drive with trigger-pressure rumble scaled by speed mode | D-pad Up/Down: speed mode 1-3 with rumble | LB: brake | RB: boost | X: manual front lights | B: 1s flicker signal | Menu/Start or Esc: safe exit | auto: front forward, rockets reverse blink
